definitions.explanation: The powerful rush of air and pressure generated by an explosion, capable of causing destruction over a wide area.

examples.japanese: {爆風|ばくふう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{割|わ}れた→割れる：00907_wareru⟧。
examples.english: The blast shattered the window glass.

examples.japanese: ⟦{爆発|ばくはつ}→爆発：03575_bakuhatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{爆風|ばくふう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{数百|すうひゃく}→数百：23368_suuhyaku⟧⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: The blast wave from the explosion reached several hundred meters away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{爆風|ばくふう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{損壊|そんかい}し、⟦{周囲|しゅうい}→周囲：03206_shuui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: The building was severely damaged by the blast, and surrounding residents were also affected.

notes:
A compound of {爆|ばく} (explosion) + {風|ふう} (wind). Refers specifically to the destructive wave of compressed air created by an explosion. Common in news coverage of bombings, industrial accidents, and in discussions of the atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

- {爆風|ばくふう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{吹|ふ}き{飛|と}ばされる→吹き飛ばす：04617_fukitobasu⟧: to be blown away by the blast

- {爆風|ばくふう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧: effects of the blast
